entry_state: Acceptance separates engineering conformance, accounting validity and scientific prediction. Exact cases and matched baselines have distinct evidence roles. E1 preserves complete disclosure content and E2 tests finite reconstruction soundness and completeness. E3 begins with a declared financial target and historical information boundary; its comparator and inference details continue next.
exit_state: The six protocols distinguish extraction, reconstruction, forecasts, sector models, numerical inference and usability. Promotion requires the declared target, comparison and uncertainty evidence; failed candidates trigger scoped repairs. The implementation stages preserve banking and insurance requirements from the initial types while deferring their engines. Concrete corpus and release requirements continue next.
findings: The forecast loss uses a declared orientation and pre-outcome scale; missing predictions cannot improve the evaluation population.
Sector and numerical checks retain the target, conditioning law and downstream quantity before speed.
The budget ladder distinguishes conformance, exposed development, retrospective evaluation and new external evidence; seeds are not a replication justification.
The stated implementation sequence remains prospective and requires its separate authorization. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
